ja: プロトタイプスーツはプレミアムバンダイで予約して手に入れよう♪
話題のアニメ「ＴＩＧＥＲ ＆ ＢＵＮＮＹ」より、第１話に登場のシックなカラーリングが人気の
バーナビー・ブルックス Jr.（プロトタイプスーツ）が、ＭＧＦシリーズでいよいよ登場！！
●●MG Figure-riseシリーズとは●●
キャラクターの再現性、圧倒的な可動性能、躍動感を表現するギミックを採用した
究極のフィギュアプラモデルシリーズ。
●●アニメ『TIGER＆BUNNY』●●
“「NEXT」能力と呼ばれる特殊な力を駆使して平和を守る「ヒーロー」が存在する街、
シュテルンビルトを舞台に、仕事も私生活も崖っぷちのベテランヒーロー、ワイルドタイガーと、
有能だが扱いにくい新人、バーナビ･ブルックス Jr.が、時に対立しながらも協力して悪に立ち向かう、
痛快バディヒーローアクション！”
“第１話”に登場のイメージを徹底再現！！
オススメポイントはココだ！！
●胸元と腕には、劇中登場した姿を忠実に再現したバーコード！！
●印象的なカラーリングを成形色で再現！！
盛りだくさんな商品仕様をチェック！
・フェイスオープンして素顔露出状態も組み換えにて再現可能！

en: Get the prototype suit by pre-ordering it at Premium Bandai♪
From the popular anime "TIGER & BUNNY", the chic coloring that appeared in the first episode is popular.
Barnaby Brooks Jr. (prototype suit) is finally available in the MGF series! !
●●What is MG Figure-rise series●●
Adopts gimmicks that express character reproducibility, overwhelming movement performance, and a sense of dynamism.
The ultimate figure plastic model series.
●●Anime “TIGER & BUNNY”●●
“A town where there are “heroes” who protect peace by making full use of special powers called “NEXT” abilities,
Set in Sternbild, Wild Tiger, a veteran hero whose work and personal life are on the brink,
Barnabi Brooks Jr., a talented but difficult newcomer, fights against evil by working together, though sometimes at odds.
Exciting buddy hero action! ”
Thoroughly reproduce the image that appeared in “Episode 1”! !
Here are the recommended points! !
-The barcode on the chest and arm is a faithful reproduction of the figure that appeared in the play! !
- Reproduce the impressive coloring with molded colors! !
Check out the various product specifications!
・You can also recreate the state where the face is opened and the real face is exposed by recombination!
・3 sets of expressive wrists are included!
・Adopts an underwear-like internal frame!
- Two types of barcode seals are included: water transfer seals and Tetron seals!
・Includes a dedicated pedestal for MGF display!
・Parts included to reproduce Good Luck Mode
1/8 scale assembly model
Target age: 15 years old or older
Product material: PS/PE/ABS
No glue is used for assembly
The finished product in the photo is a prototype. The actual product may differ.
The finished product in the photo is painted.
Seals are included to reproduce the facial expressions of the face parts.
